gold_notes: Immunex's MD&A product sales table (net product sales by product, USD millions; the Enbrel row). Enbrel sales began Nov. 4, 1998 (the 10-K: 'Sales of ENBREL commenced on November 4, 1998, and totaled $12.7 million for 1998'), so the full-year figure is all fourth-quarter sales and the first three quarters of 1998 had none (the Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 1998 lists no Enbrel sales). Enbrel product sales as Immunex recorded them: U.S. sales from the Nov. 4, 1998 launch, and U.S. plus Canada from the first quarter of 2001 (Immunex's 2001 Form 10-K states Enbrel was approved in Canada in December 2000 and became commercially available there in March 2001, and that Immunex records all Enbrel product sales in the U.S. and Canada). American Home Products owned Enbrel rights, and booked sales, outside the U.S. and Canada, so these are not worldwide sales.
revenue_scope: U.S. (1998Q4-2000Q4), U.S. and Canada (2001Q1-2002Q1); American Home Products had rights and booked sales elsewhere
